title: Medical training therapy
description: Safe, targeted exercise therapy tailored to conditions such as sciatica, disc herniation, chronic back pain, and post-operative musculoskeletal rehabilitation.
longDescription: Medical training therapy is a structured, exercise-based approach that combines physiotherapy knowledge with targeted strength, mobility, and functional training. Programs are individually adapted based on each patient's condition, goals, and level of ability, with a focus on long-term recovery and prevention of future problems.
